r1-hero-sources.transcript: The Medicine Passport home screen shows medicines due now. A medicine is found by search and reviewed before saving. Today's timeline lists morning and night doses. A guidance passage is read aloud. A family caregiver's bounded permissions are shown.

r2-add-medicine.transcript: The patient searches for a medicine by name, selects it from the results, reviews the type, amount, frequency and food instruction with typing-free pickers, adds the reason, and saves. The medicine then appears in their Medicine Passport.

r3-timeline.transcript: From the home screen, the patient opens today's full schedule. Today's medicines are grouped by morning and night. The patient marks a dose as taken and the timeline shows it as recorded.

r4-listen.transcript: On the help screen, the patient taps Listen. The control changes to Stop while the guidance is read aloud, then the patient stops playback. (The demonstration video itself is silent.)

r5-offline.transcript: With the network disconnected, saved medicine information stays visible and an offline notice appears. The patient records a dose, which is saved on the device. When the connection returns, the change syncs automatically.

r6-caregiver.transcript: From caregiver management, the patient opens a new invitation, enters the caregiver's number, and reviews exactly what the caregiver will be allowed to do — bounded permissions chosen by the patient.

r7-share-doctor.transcript: The patient chooses what to include and how long the link lasts, then creates a share. The doctor opens a structured Medicine Passport summary on their own device — current medicines with ingredients and instructions, recent changes, and a PDF option. The QR/link screen and the share token are deliberately not shown in this clip.

audio.spokenText: This is your home screen. It shows which medicines to take now, and anything that needs your attention.
